phase: 1C-A — transaction journal foundation / tests-first, NOT simulation-activated
accepted_changes: Added opt-in rollbackMode=journal to transaction-core only; default transaction behavior remains legacy snapshot/scoped unless explicitly requested
Added pre-execution Full Snapshot fallback for unproven writer contracts, structural writers, and unproven validation
Added conservative journal-to-full promotion before joined writers and mutating/unproven critical hooks
Added terminal irreversible critical ordering guard so persistence cannot execute before later rollback-capable critical work
Added primitive own-data asset field journal with descriptor restoration that preserves existing key order
Fixed scoped rollback root-order restoration to avoid accessor reads when root order is already unchanged
Added Phase1C adversarial 8-test contract and 600-asset full-vs-journal equivalence gate

Every join currently promotes a journal transaction to Full Snapshot; proven joined-writer admission is Phase1C-B work
Mutating/unproven critical hooks promote to Full Snapshot; only explicitly proven read-only critical hooks may remain journal-backed
Asset field journal accepts only pre-existing own primitive data properties declared by the caller
Node24/ESLint/full CI, Apple/WKWebView/native, and physical iPhone tests remain pending
